# docs(adrs): record the review and approval process

## Why

Changes to review and approval policy left overlapping rules about how many reviews a pull request needs, who can approve it and which findings block a merge.

## Behavior change

The decision record index now links to the rules for review tiers, reviewer selection, verdicts, approvals, and merge provenance. Each record states the rule and its effect on work in the repository.

## Decisions

tbhb made the decisions below, with some details settled under delegated authority.

- 2026-11-11 covers records 0008, 0009, and 0011 through 0014. The approval rule in 0009 also reflects decisions dated 2026-11-08, 2026-11-22, and 2026-11-23.
- 2026-11-12 covers records 0010 and 0015 through 0017.
- 2026-11-22 covers records 0005 and 0006. That date also supplies parts of 0002 and 0004.
- 2026-11-23 covers records 0001 through 0004 and 0007.

## Verification

Checked that the index links resolve and match each record’s title and description. Checked that all records follow the template and stay within the pilot’s length limit.

## Human steering

tbhb authorized a prose-only pilot to record the standing review and approval rules in the public wiki.
